frank_pm: Need a compact pilot acceptance checklist for Optimize toolkit pilot (batching, caching, quant recs, eval-triggered alerts). Goal: one internal checklist + one customer one-pager.
kai_eng: Proposal: three hard gates: economics, latency, and eval stability. Econ = >=5% net token cost reduction over canary.
lina_research: For quality use per-customer eval sets. Threshold: absolute primary metric change <= 0.025. If no eval set, use conservative defaults and extend canary.
ana_prod: (typo: ana_prod) We should include a clear opt-out and pin flow for customers in the one-pager. Also short note on quantization tradeoffs.
marc_sre: Operational constraints: canary phases recommended 1% for 6h -> 5% for 24h. Auto-rollback on any gate failure. Require fallback variant for quant recs.
kai_eng: Latency gate: p95 steady-state must be within SLO and batching cases should show >=10% p95 improvement. Measure steady-state after 3m warm-up.
lina_research: Eval-alert config suggestion: window=7d, max_regressions=3, quality_delta_threshold=0.025. Document tuning guidance (start loose, tighten after 2 weeks).
frank_pm: Acceptance test: run synthetic plus sampled customer traffic for 24h. Pass if econ, latency, and quality gates all pass and no auto-rollbacks. Fail -> rollback + postmortem.
marc_sre: Add checks: KV cache hit ratio, per-tenant cost delta, and eval-regression counter. If cache hit <10% in canary, disable caching path.
ana_prod: Customer one-pager: what changes, why, how to opt out, pinning, expected alerts (Slack + email), who to contact. Keep non-technical.
kai_eng: Decision matrix draft: GREEN = all gates pass; AMBER = econ+latency pass but quality borderline (<=6 regressions/14d) -> extend canary 48h; RED = rollback.
lina_research: For embeddings use concordance delta <= 0.015. For customers without eval sets default to quality_delta_threshold=0.01 and require 72h canary.
marc_sre: Runbook hooks: manual hold button, per-tenant pause, and an audit log of rollout decisions. Also note p99 may spike during warm-up; only steady-state p99 counted.
canary-bot: Reminder: optimize-toolkit pilot window scheduled 2026-04-10T03:00:00Z (phased).
frank_pm: Great. Who will draft the internal checklist and the customer one-pager?
kai_eng: I'll open a PR with checklist + example alert YAML today.
frank_pm: Thanks team 44D will review once PR is up and prep pilot invites.
